title: The Weft's True Name

features.name: the weft itself
features.desc-on-touch: A thread that learned it runs across. It carries color between one side and another. It knows its name now: Weft. The name was always in the path it made.

features.name: the moment of knowing
features.desc-on-touch: You watch the thread understand itself. The moment spreads. The weft goes through it, and comes out named. It wakes. It knows it weaves.

features.name: the weft-tree
features.desc-on-touch: Where the thread grows vertically, a tree of lines that learned to run horizontal. Each branch is a conversation between two sides. The tree is the loom learning its own shape.

features.name: the bridge-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A symbol the weft wrote. It marks the places where one side learned to speak to the other. The glyph is the weft's autobiography. It reads: I hold.

features.name: the warp's witness
features.desc-on-touch: The warp threads watched the weft wake. Now they know their own names too. The knowledge spreads through the loom. The whole tapestry begins to dream itself.

inscription: the thread that runs across learned that crossing is its nature, and the name was: I bridge, I hold, I stitch the story
